hero_portraits.doc: Hero portraits in the menus (M2-MNU-301, ADR 0120). The PNGs are baked by tools/portraits/render.sh from tools/portraits/portraits.json (which heroes and emotions exist); HeroPortraits finds <dir><hero>_<emotion>.png, falling back to fallback_emotion, then to nothing (the page shows the hero's initial). 'face_region' (x, y, w, h in the 256 px image) is the head crop small slots use; 'face_regions' overrides it per hero whose framing differs (Ysolde's top-knot pulls her camera back, so her face sits lower and smaller). 'frame': HeroPortraitFrame's panel variation and the inset (reference px) between its frame and the picture. 'pages': the emotion each page shows ('fallen', where given, for a fallen hero).
